description: A man in a pale lab coat, seen from behind and to the side, writes with chalk on a large dark blackboard in a dim laboratory. The board holds a grid of small chalk glyphs in rows and columns, several looking like letter triplets, with circled cells. A string of beads of different shapes hangs at the right edge of the board. Shelves of books, glassware and a retort stand sit in the shadowy room. The painting runs edge to edge, with only the board's own wooden frame visible.
reason: The chalkboard grid is painted with letter-like triplets (several read as U, A, C, G combinations), which counts as text in the picture. The glyphs should be replaced with abstract non-letter marks or left blurred. The rest of the scene (lab, chalkboard grid, hanging beads) matches the card.
